description: Create a new announcement in the Announcement Center. This is visible to all or selected groups and can trigger notifications/emails — use deliberately. Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

activities.description: Publish to the activity feed (default true)

deleteTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) to automatically delete the announcement

groups.description: Group IDs to target, or ['everyone'] for all users (default)

plainMessage.description: Plain-text version of the message (defaults to message)

scheduleTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) to publish the announcement later

name: create_announcement
title: Create Announcement
